question: Who was appointed as the Chief Justice of the Orissa High Court in March 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Justice Harish Tandon**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Justice Harish Tandon was appointed as the Chief Justice of the Orissa High Court in March 2025.
 
• He replaced the outgoing Chief Justice, bringing in his vast judicial experience to lead the High Court.
 
• Justice Tandon has a distinguished career in law, serving in various capacities in the judiciary before this appointment.
 
• His appointment as the Chief Justice was made by the President of India in consultation with the Collegium, following the established procedure for judicial appointments in India.
 
• The Orissa High Court, located in Cuttack, is one of the prominent High Courts in India, with jurisdiction over the state of Odisha.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Justice Joymalya Bagchi**
 
 
• Justice Joymalya Bagchi is a notable judge who has served in various capacities in the Indian judiciary.
 
• He has contributed significantly to the legal framework with his judgments and legal acumen.
 
• Although not associated with the Orissa High Court, his name is prominent in other judicial roles.
 
 
 
• **Justice Arun Palli**
 
 
• Justice Arun Palli is a judge with a remarkable career in the Indian judiciary.
 
• He has been involved in significant legal decisions and is known for his expertise in constitutional and civil matters.
 
• He is associated with a different High Court and was not appointed as the Chief Justice of Orissa High Court.
 
 
 
• **Justice Hima Kohli**
 
 
• Justice Hima Kohli is a distinguished judge and has served as the Chief Justice of Telangana High Court.
 
• She has a reputation for her in-depth understanding of legal issues and her contribution to justice delivery in India.
 
• Her appointment as Chief Justice was for another High Court, not the Orissa High Court.
 
 
 
• **Orissa High Court**
 
 
• The Orissa High Court was established on 26 July 1948 and serves as the apex legal authority in the state of Odisha.
 
• It is located in Cuttack and addresses a wide range of legal matters, including constitutional, civil, and criminal cases.
 
• The Chief Justice of a High Court plays a crucial role in administering justice and overseeing the functioning of the judiciary within its jurisdiction.
